preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is an integer between 1 and 10^5 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= K <= 10**12 for K in K_list)
preconditions.description: Each K in the input is an integer between 1 and 10^12 inclusive.
The number of K values provided matches T.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly T lines, one for each test case.

postconditions.expression: all(is_magical(int(output_lines[i])) and rank_of_magical(int(output_lines[i])) == K_list[i] for i in range(T))
postconditions.description: For each test case i, the output line is the K_list[i]-th magical number, where magical numbers are ordered by increasing value starting from 0.
